MEA Clarifies Misleading Social Media Post on Spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal's Remarks

The Ministry of External Affairs clarified a misleading social media post regarding protest funding. Spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated he had no information on foreign funding claims. The CJP-led protests were discussed, but the details of the funding row are unclear. The MEA fact-checked viral posts attributing false statements to the spokesperson.
